structData.heading: Apply online
structData.text_span: You can apply for any Nova Horizon credit card with the online application form on our website. Rates, fees and limits for each card are in that card's product terms.
structData.title: How to apply for a Nova Horizon credit card

structData.heading: Help choosing a card
structData.text_span: The Nova Horizon assistant can explain and compare our cards and point you to the online application form. Applications are submitted through that form.
structData.title: How to apply for a Nova Horizon credit card

structData.heading: Application decisions
structData.text_span: The bank reviews each application and decides approval and the starting credit limit. Applying does not guarantee approval or a specific limit.
structData.title: How to apply for a Nova Horizon credit card

structData.heading: Due dates
structData.text_span: Each statement shows your payment due date and minimum payment. Pay at least the minimum by the due date to keep your account in good standing.
structData.title: Card payments and due dates

structData.heading: Ways to pay
structData.text_span: You can pay your card from a Nova Horizon checking or savings account with bill pay in online banking.
structData.title: Card payments and due dates

structData.heading: Late or returned payments
structData.text_span: A late or returned payment may add a fee and, on some cards, a penalty APR. The amounts for each card are in its product terms.
structData.title: Card payments and due dates

structData.heading: Requesting an increase
structData.text_span: You can ask the assistant for a higher credit limit at any time. The bank decides eligibility when you make the request.
structData.title: How credit limit increases work

structData.heading: How the bank decides
structData.text_span: The bank considers your account history and the card's maximum limit, listed in its product terms. A request can be approved in full, in part, or declined.
structData.title: How credit limit increases work

structData.heading: Graduation reviews
structData.text_span: Secured card accounts are reviewed for an upgrade to an unsecured card. On-time payments help. The review timeline is in the secured card's product terms.
structData.title: Moving from a secured card to an unsecured card

structData.heading: Your security deposit
structData.text_span: For questions about your refundable security deposit, ask the assistant or send us a secure message in online banking.
structData.title: Moving from a secured card to an unsecured card

structData.heading: Lost or stolen card
structData.text_span: If your card is lost or stolen, tell the assistant right away. The card can be blocked so it cannot be used, and a replacement card can be issued.
structData.title: Lost or stolen cards and suspected fraud

structData.heading: Suspected fraud
structData.text_span: If you see a charge you do not recognize, report it to the assistant as soon as possible. We review the activity with you and can replace your card if it was compromised.
structData.title: Lost or stolen cards and suspected fraud

structData.heading: Fraud alerts
structData.text_span: We may contact you about unusual activity. We never ask for your full card number, PIN or password in a call or message we start.
structData.title: Lost or stolen cards and suspected fraud

structData.heading: Starting a dispute
structData.text_span: If a purchase is wrong, was not delivered or was not as described, contact the merchant first. If that does not fix it, contact us through the assistant or secure messaging.
structData.title: Disputing a card transaction

structData.heading: During a dispute
structData.text_span: We review the charge with you and let you know the outcome when the review is complete.
structData.title: Disputing a card transaction

structData.heading: Card fees
structData.text_span: Card fees can include an annual fee, foreign transaction fees, balance transfer and cash advance fees, and late or returned payment fees. Not every card has every fee.
structData.title: Credit card fees overview

structData.heading: Where to find fee amounts
structData.text_span: The exact fee amounts and rates for each card are listed in that card's product terms. Your statement shows any fees charged in the period.
structData.title: Credit card fees overview

structData.heading: Support channels
structData.text_span: You can reach support through the assistant or through secure messaging in online banking.
structData.title: Contacting Nova Horizon support

structData.heading: Talking to a specialist
structData.text_span: The assistant can connect you with a human support specialist when you need help it cannot provide.
structData.title: Contacting Nova Horizon support
